messages:
maria: FYI saw a spike from the replayer yesterday evening that coincided with a hosted-api P95 blip for small models. :eyes:
aj: ugh, saw that on the infra alerts too. did we backfill into the main serving pool?
ravi: we did — the replay job started hitting capacity while a couple of high-traffic customers were warming up. routing sent some inference to lower-cost hosts and latency spiked.
sylvie: can we move replayer traffic into a best-effort QoS lane? ideally a separate pool so it can't steal serving capacity.
maria: yes — proposal: create a backfill/prefetch pool with quota and a dedicated routing tag. then update routing policy so any request from replay-ingest has route: backfill-pool (best-effort).
kevin: +1. also need a quick dashboard metric to show "replayer qps" vs "serving available concurrency". current dashboards bundle too many signals.
aj: I sketched a tiny config for the routing rule. thoughts?
```
routing.rules:
  - match: request.origin == "replayer"
    action: route_to_pool
    pool: backfill-pool
    priority: low
    throttle: 0.05  # cap at 5% of cluster tokens
```
maria: Looks good. I worry about the throttle semantics — we need a circuit-breaker for retries. if replayer sees 429 it should backoff exponential
heka: Ops runbook change: when backfill throttles start hitting 429s, replayer should pause and resume with exponential backoff. Add alert: backfill-429-rate > 2% for 2m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot applied patch r/infra/495 to add pool "backfill-pool" in staging.
ravi: testing in staging now. one thing — our current quota accounting is token-based and doesn't differentiate host-priority. we should add a quota bucket type: "workload_class" (serving|backfill).
sylvie: agree. UI/Console change request: let teams see quota usage by workload_class in console cost panels and set soft-limits per pool.
kevin: For quick mitigation in prod, can we enable a temporary soft-quota on replays (like 30% decrease) while we finalize pool?
maria: I applied a temporary job-level cap in dashboard for yesterday, but it's manual. ops-bot can we automate: apply job cap 30% to any replayer job older than 24h?
ops-bot: runbook: added automation toggle. "auto-cap-stale-replayers" set to false by default. toggled to true for the evening window.
aj: One more thing — routing fallback if backfill-pool is full: we should NOT route to main-serving. Instead fail fast and push to DLQ with a retry schedule. Redistribute later.
heka: yes. dlq + scheduled retry prevents thundering-herd. add a small retention dashboard for DLQ size and age.
kevin: We should also update the rollout UX in Console so admins can configure priority lanes and preview capacity impact. Right now it's hidden under infra settings.
sylvie: I'll add a UX ticket. simple preview: given N tokens in cluster, show max backfill qps and estimated impact on P95.
maria: Actionable plan:
- short (P0): enable backfill-pool in prod, toggle auto-cap for stale replayers, add alert for backfill-429-rate (maria, aj)
- medium (P1): quota bucket "workload_class", console preview panel, DLQ metrics (ravi, sylvie)
- long (P2): rollout canary for routing rules + circuit-breaker library for replayer (heka, kevin)
aj: I'll open the infra PR for quota bucket and add tests.
ravi: staging tests passed: when backfill-pool is full, requests return 429 and go to DLQ. latency for main-serving unchanged.
sylvie: can someone add a dashboard card under SLOs: "Backfill pressure" with graphs: replayer qps, backfill-pool utilization, backfill-429-rate, DLQ size.
kevin: I'll create the dashboard PR and include a small walkthrough for supports.
maria: timeline? can we get short tasks done today to avoid another night blip?
aj: I'll get the infra PR out this morning, ops-bot will enable auto-cap in prod for 4h window after deploy.
ops-bot: automation: auto-cap-stale-replayers enabled until 2359060000 (4h).
heka: good. also capturing the circuit-breaker pattern in the runbook so any new replayer implementation uses it.
maria: thanks all. follow-ups: aj to PR, ravi to DLQ dashboards, sylvie to Console preview ticket, kevin to SLO dashboard. we'll reconvene 0900 UTC tomorrow to check metrics. :thumbsup:
